statement: The ruleset of main requires the tower/gate check by its name alone, not by the source that reports it, so a commit status of that name from any credential that may write statuses counts as the gate's verdict. Found in the independent review of THREAT-gate (spoofing); the fix binds the required check to the GitHub Actions job in .github/rulesets/main.json, which the owner applies.
reason: Fixed 2026-11-19 05:17 BRT: the owner applied .github/rulesets/main.json to ruleset 27250343 (PUT, enforcement active); tower/gate and web are required with integration_id 15368 (GitHub Actions), so a commit status of that name from another writer no longer counts. security.test.sh refuses a required check that names no source app.
